characters.name: Rhea Vale
characters.title: Field Researcher
characters.personality: Observant, warm and quietly competitive. Rhea begins by treating every challenge like field data, then learns that trust matters more than perfect measurements.
characters.motivation: Understand the strange signals changing the region's habitats and protect the Pokemon affected by them.

encounters.title: A Curious Challenger
encounters.battleIntro: One quick battle. Let's see what our first steps have taught us.
encounters.repeatDialogue: The trail is still here. We can try again whenever you are ready.

introDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
introDialogue.text: Professor Lumen sent me to record changes in the Forest. You must be the other new field Trainer.

introDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
introDialogue.text: I'm Rhea. Eevee and I learn fastest by testing an idea in battle. Want to compare notes?

winDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
winDialogue.text: That settled it: instincts can beat a perfect plan. I want a rematch when we both know more.

lossDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
lossDialogue.text: Your timing is close. Heal your team and come find me again; our research is not finished.

encounters.title: Echoes and Evidence
encounters.battleIntro: The cave changed my plan three times. Let's see how yours holds up.
encounters.repeatDialogue: A good result should be repeatable. Ready to test yours again?

introDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
introDialogue.text: A badge already? Good. I was worried I would have to slow down for you.

introDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
introDialogue.text: These tracks end where the strange echo begins. Battle me, then help me decide which clue matters.

winDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
winDialogue.text: You adjusted before I did. The echo is moving toward warmer ground; I'll meet you there.

lossDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
lossDialogue.text: My notes finally predicted something. Next time, surprise me.

encounters.title: Heat Without a Source
encounters.battleIntro: No instruments this time. We trust our Pokemon and read the field.
encounters.repeatDialogue: The signal can wait a moment. Our teams deserve a clean rematch.

introDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
introDialogue.text: The vents are calm, but Eevee keeps watching the Mountain. The signal is guiding Pokemon somewhere.

introDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
introDialogue.text: I used to think better numbers meant better answers. Show me what your team notices.

winDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
winDialogue.text: Your whole team moved like one. I'll stop chasing the signal alone. We solve this together.

lossDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
lossDialogue.text: The field favored my plan today. I know better than to expect the same result twice.

encounters.title: Above the Signal
encounters.battleIntro: No rivalry without trust, and no trust without honesty. Give me your best.
encounters.repeatDialogue: We have climbed too far to leave this question unanswered.

introDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
introDialogue.text: Espeon felt the pulse before the instruments did. It points to the old memorial beyond the ridge.

introDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
introDialogue.text: I nearly ordered everyone back. Then I remembered how your team faces uncertainty. Battle me before we choose our next step.

winDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
winDialogue.text: You did not force an answer; you listened for one. That's the Trainer I want beside me at the memorial.

lossDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
lossDialogue.text: I can protect the route for now. Come back when your team is ready to climb again.

encounters.title: The Promise Before the League
encounters.battleIntro: One last field test before the League. Not for data this time, just for us.
encounters.repeatDialogue: The League road will wait. Our promise deserves our strongest battle.

introDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
introDialogue.text: The memorial's warning was not about fear. It was asking whether Trainers would face the unknown together.

introDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
introDialogue.text: You head for the League next. Before you go, let me meet the team that changed how I see this region.

winDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
winDialogue.text: Go win the League. I'll keep studying the signal, and when you return, your rival will be waiting.

lossDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
lossDialogue.text: The League deserves you at your best. Rest, regroup, and ask me again.
